**Tier 2.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `activity`, `catalog`, `commerce`, `identity`, `messaging`, `plugins`, `settings`, `vintedReviews`, `vouchers`.

Currently imports: `cart`, `commerce`, `identity`, `plugins`, `settings`.

Feature map entry: `payments` in [docs/features.json](../../../docs/features.json). Run `npm run feature -- payments` for its full span.

## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

Card details never reach this service: it stores Stripe PaymentMethod ids and
the retention decision the customer made about them.

A one-time card is bound to a checkout session and must not survive it. A saved
card is session-independent. Confusing the two either charges a card the
customer did not agree to keep, or loses one they did.

<!-- invariants:end -->
